answer.reason: The verses tell of Judas Iscariot's bargain, his betrayal of Jesus with a kiss, and his repentance and death.

clauses.english: agreed with the chief priests to betray Jesus for thirty pieces of silver
clauses.quote: they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver

clauses.english: betrayed Jesus with a kiss to the crowd sent by the chief priests
repented, cast down the silver in the temple, and hanged himself

doubts: LUK 6:16 also names Judas the brother of James, a different man, so that part of the verse was left out.
